reason: The cited evidence shows that an inverted BCC+B2 microstructure with discrete B2 precipitates can improve ductility and maintain high strength in RHEAs (E1), but it does not provide any data on TiVNbTa specifically, on aging conditions (~850 K), on precipitate size (5–15 nm), or on strengthening at 1273 K. E2 is about grain-size strengthening in CoCrFeMnNi and is irrelevant to precipitation in TiVNbTa. Thus, the key premises lack specific prior support.
premises: TiVNbTa can be aged to form nanoscale B2 precipitates
B2 precipitates will be coherent and uniformly dispersed
Coherent B2 precipitates will strengthen the alloy at 1273 K
Aging at ~850 K will produce 5–15 nm precipitates
Strengthening will reach 450–500 MPa without losing ductility
